Name: The pink cat of the circus
Author: Brokendrill
Description:
粉色小猫？也需有点奇怪，但是在奇幻马戏团里当然可以存在，对吗？（也许以后我会补充一下其他建筑的美化，打造一个粉蓝色系的农场？）文件应该没什么问题，下载后直接拖入mods里，之后去罗宾那里选择建造就可以看见了。不过这个只是普通初始鸡舍的美化，也就是说你升级鸡舍之后就看不见了，因为我一开始是打算画一个我之前的蘑菇屋配套的鸡舍，后面开始画的时候突然脑袋里出现了马戏团旋转木马的画面，然后就画出来了现在这个鸡舍，之后我可能会补充一下大鸡舍和豪华鸡舍的美化。
放置路径:Stardew valley/mods
I used the translation software below.:
Pink kitten? It needs to be a little strange, but it can certainly exist in a fantasy circus, right? (Maybe I'll supplement the beautification of other buildings in the future and build a pink-blue farm? ) There should be no problem with the file. After downloading, drag it directly into mods, then go to Robin's place and choose to build it, and you can see it. However, this is just the beautification of the ordinary initial chicken coop, which means that you can't see it after upgrading the chicken coop, because at first I was going to draw a chicken coop matching my previous mushroom house. Later, when I started drawing, I suddenly had a picture of the circus merry-go-round in my head, and then I drew the current chicken coop. After that, I might add the beautification of the big chicken coop and luxury chicken coop.
Path: Stardew valley/mods
